caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica means learning to welcome whatever the cordillera gives you. Some miles are fast and wide open; others ask you to get off the saddle, lean into the grade, and let the cloud forest swallow everything except the next few metres of gravel. I build our routes for riders who appreciate both.
